question: I'm the account owner and my payment failed. Where should I replace the payment method?
answer: As the account owner, update your payment method under Settings > Billing > Payment methods. After updating it, select Retry payment if that option appears. If the payment still fails, contact your card issuer or CloudDesk support. Do not enter full card details in a support message. [faq-failed-payment-001][manual-billing-navigation-001]

question: Please explain the self-service steps for ending my subscription. I'll do it myself.
answer: You can cancel your subscription yourself in the app: go to Settings > Billing > Manage subscription > Cancel subscription. The cancellation takes effect at the end of your current paid billing period, and your access remains available until then. Note that cancellation does not automatically issue a refund. [manual-billing-navigation-001][policy-cancellation-001]
